title: Carlos and His Parents
text:
My name is Carlos. My father is a farmer. He works on a big farm near the town. Every morning he feeds the cows and the chickens. He gets up very early.

My mother is a police officer. She works in the city at night. She wears a blue uniform. Her job is important because she helps people. On Sundays, she sleeps all day.

questions.text: What does Carlos's father do every morning?
options: He feeds the cows and the chickens

questions.text: What colour is the mother's uniform?
Why does Carlos's father get up very early?
options: Because farm work starts early in the day
Because he likes to sleep late

questions.text: What can we infer about the mother's job?
options: It is important and she helps people
It is not a job for helping others
It is a job that is done only in the day
It is a job at a school

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Carlos. Meu pai é fazendeiro. Ele trabalha em uma grande fazenda perto da cidade. Todas as manhãs ele alimenta as vacas e as galinhas. Ele acorda muito cedo.
Minha mãe é policial. Ela trabalha na cidade à noite. Ela usa um uniforme azul. O trabalho dela é importante porque ela ajuda as pessoas. Aos domingos, ela dorme o dia todo.
